home.featureE2eeDesc: Messages are encrypted on your device. Even we can't read them.
home.featureBurnDesc: Destroy all traces of your conversation with one tap.

walletLogin.title: Burned Chats
walletLogin.subtitle: Connect your TON wallet to sign in in the browser.
walletLogin.supportedWallets: Tonkeeper, MyTonWallet, Telegram @wallet — via QR or deep link
walletLogin.errorRejected: The wallet closed the request. Try again when you are ready.
walletLogin.errorProof: The server could not verify the wallet signature. Try reconnecting.
walletLogin.errorTimeout: Connection timed out. Check your network and try again.
walletLogin.errorNetwork: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and API URL.

accountLinking.sectionSubtitle: Connect Telegram and your TON wallet to the same account.
accountLinking.walletInstructions: Your browser profile is wallet-only. Create a secure link from here, open it inside Telegram Mini App once, and the app completes the bind automatically.
accountLinking.telegramCompleteHint: Mini App opens with a pending link — we finish when this screen loads.
accountLinking.telegramLinkedToast: Telegram linked to your wallet account.
accountLinking.conflict: This Telegram account or wallet is already linked elsewhere.

wallet.tonForGasAria: Native TON balance for network fees
wallet.receiveHint: Scan the QR code with a TON wallet, or share the link / copy your address below.
wallet.receiveQrAria: QR code: open transfer to this wallet in a TON app
wallet.historyEmptyHint: Pull down to refresh. Or jump straight to receiving BURN below.
wallet.amountSliderAria: Amount as a percentage of your balance
wallet.usernameNotResolved: Resolving Telegram @username in-app is not available yet — use a TON address.
wallet.feeEnterAmount: Enter an amount to see fee breakdown.
wallet.errAmountPositive: Amount must be greater than zero.

staking.connectHint: Connect your TON wallet to view positions and stake BURN.
staking.emptyHint: Stake your BURN to join the rewards pool. Pick a tier that matches how long you can lock tokens.
staking.timelineEmpty: No active locks. Flexible tier or unlocked positions do not appear here.
staking.noStakeTier: You have no stake in this tier yet.
staking.claimHistoryEmpty: Claims you confirm in this app will appear here (last 10).
staking.lockConfirm: Your tokens will be locked until {{date}}. You cannot unstake earlier.
staking.apyTooltip: Indicative APY based on current pool emission and an illustrative tier TVL. Actual rewards depend on participation and on-chain parameters.
staking.amountPositive: Amount must be greater than zero.
staking.unstakeClaimFirst: You have pending rewards ({{amount}}). Claim first so nothing is left on-chain before unstaking.

calculator.title: APY calculator
calculator.phase2Disclaimer: After year 3, only transaction fees fund staking rewards. Indicative APY is usually much lower than during Phase 1.
calculator.amountTooltip: Hypothetical amount you stake in this tier. Your share of the tier and APY depend on total tier TVL (illustrative baseline from TOKENOMICS plus any position you already have in that tier).
calculator.amountHint: Slider uses your wallet balance when connected; otherwise up to {{max}}.
calculator.amountSliderAria: Calculator stake amount as percentage of max
calculator.tierTooltip: Each tier receives a fixed share of daily pool emission; higher tiers earn more but require a longer lock.
calculator.needAmount: Enter a stake amount to see estimates.
calculator.minAmount: Use at least {{min}} for a meaningful APY estimate.
calculator.apyTooltip: Annualized from estimated daily rewards. Illustrative only — see TOKENOMICS for assumptions.
calculator.shareTierTooltip: Your stake as a fraction of total tier stake after your deposit (scenario model).
calculator.rewardDayTooltip: Pool emission × tier reward share × your fraction of tier stake.
calculator.noEmission: No pool emission for this scenario.
calculator.chartAria: Bar chart of indicative APY by tier
calculator.modalNeedAmount: Enter an amount to see indicative APY and reward estimates.

chatRequest.title: Start Secure Chat
chatRequest.subtitle: Send an encrypted chat request
chatRequest.secretHint: Recipient must answer to accept the request. If you enable this, both the question and the expected answer are required — they must match what only your contact knows (max {{max}} characters each).
chatRequest.expectedAnswerHint: Only the recipient types this when accepting; you set the answer the server will check against (plain text in the app for v1).
chatRequest.securityNote: End-to-end encrypted. We can't read your messages.

delete.mixedSelection: Select only your own messages, or as owner you may include any

burnDialog.title: Burn this chat?
burnDialog.description: This will permanently destroy your chat with <1>{{name}}</1>.
burnDialog.warning: All messages and encryption keys will be erased on both devices. This action cannot be undone.

incomingRequest.subtitle: Someone wants to start a secure conversation with you

incomingRequest.securityNote: End-to-end encrypted. Messages cannot be read by anyone else.

verification.subtitlePending: Compare this fingerprint with your peer to ensure secure connection.
verification.subtitleVerified: Both parties have verified the fingerprint.
verification.subtitleMismatch: Fingerprint mismatch detected. This connection may be compromised.
verification.mismatchWarning: The fingerprints do not match. This could indicate a man-in-the-middle attack. Do not share sensitive information in this chat.
verification.helpText: Ask your peer to read their fingerprint symbols over a voice call or in person. If they match, press "Fingerprint Matches".

manage.title: Room Settings
